description:
Use this when the user wants to bring a long video into RipClip so it can be clipped: "clip this Twitch VOD",
        "turn my Kick stream into shorts", "use this podcast episode", "clip my last stream", "clip this video" with a
        file attached. Give url: a Kick or Twitch past broadcast (VOD), highlight or clip link, an Apple Podcasts
        episode, a Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive share link, or a direct link to a video file. Or give channel (the
        streamer's name) with platform "kick" or "twitch", or a channel page link such as kick.com/name: that imports
        the channel's newest past broadcast. Or file: a video the user attached, where the assistant passes attached
        files to tools (ChatGPT). A file on the user's device that can't be attached here: they upload it at
        https://ripclip.org (Upload on the home page) and say when it is done; list_projects then shows it.
        rights must be true only after the user confirms they own the video or have permission to use it.
        request_key is optional (never ask the user; left empty, RipClip makes one). Returns job_id at once; poll
        job_status, which gives the project_id when it is done.
        Not for: YouTube links (not supported: if it is the user's own video, they download the file from their YouTube
        account and attach or upload it), a stream that is still live (import it after it ends), or cutting clips
        (find_clips) and posting (draft_post). Free: importing spends no Horizon Units. Next: estimate_hu, then
        find_clips.

PhotoFile.description: a file the user attached in ChatGPT (Apps SDK openai/fileParams: download_url and file_id always come)
